To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a new sensor fusion method based on the complementary filter as a low-bandwidth filter and the modified Kalman filter for the delay compensation of the tilt sensor is proposed and the results of the experiments show proper performance of this method.

the delay compensation of the tilt sensor is performed using the data fusion of sensors and the accuracy in the angle measurement is improved from the original value of 18° to the value of 0.8 ° in the high frequency tests and the bandwidth of the angle measurement is increased from 0.15 Hz to 6 Hz.
the proposed method has been able to compensate the delay and enhance the bandwidth of the MEMS accelerometer based tilt sensor using data fusion technique.
